description: Minimal permissions for Builder Pro AI: core IPC + UI settings store + folder picker + scoped fs. The daemon is launchd-managed (spec §8.3), never shell-spawned by the app, so shell:default is retained for the tauri-plugin-shell runtime init only — no allow-execute/allow-spawn scope is granted (externalBin sidecar bundling is a tauri.conf.json build-time setting, not a runtime capability).
